simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נָתִיב (H5410) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 26 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: נָתִיב (nâthîyb) means a (beaten) track First listed occurrence: Hos 2 8.

definitions.full: H5410. nathiyb נָתִיב noun masculine Job 28:7 path, pathway (as raised ); — absolute ׳נ 18:10 3 t.; construct נְתִיב Psa 119:35 ; suffix 3feminine singular נְתִיבָהֿ Prov 12:28 (si vera lectio, see below; on omission of Mappik see Ges § 91e , see below); — path Job 18:10 (figurative) 28:7 ; 41:24 (track); Psa 78:50 (figurative); מִצְוֺתֶיךָ נְתִיב 119:35 the path of thy commands ; אַלמָֿוֶת נְתִיבָה דֶּרֶךְ Prov 12:28 the journey of her pathway is no-death! || חַיִּים צְדָקָה בְּאֹרַח Ew Be De. see אַל a above; others read אֶלֿ , and either translate ׳נ by-paths (Hi Str), or substitute a synonym of 'wickedness' (compare Now Frankenb; Perles Analekten 87 f. נִתְעָבִים after Levy ChWB i. 28 b ). נְתִיבָה noun feminine id.; — absolute ׳נ Isa 43:16 , suffix נְתִּיבָתִי Job 30:13 2 t. נְתִיבָתָם Prov 1:15 ; plural absolute נְתִיכוֺת 8:2 +; construct id. Job 38:20 +; suffix נְתִיבֹתַי 19:8 ; Lam 3:9 , נְתִיבֹתָיו Job 24:13 , etc.; — path: 1 lit נְתִיבוֺת הֹלְכֵי Judg 5:6 goers on paths , i.e. travellers, Prov 8:2 ; Isa 58:12 (Oort Lag Klo נְתִיצוֺת but against this Du); path through sea 43:16 (in figurative); of path to house of (personified) light and darkness Job 38:20 . 2 often || דֶּרֶךְ a. = course of life Job 19:8 ; 30:13 ; Lam 3:9 ; Psa 119:105 ; 142:4 , of Israel Hosea 2:8 ; of path of God's appointment Isa 42:16 . b. of moral action, and character: paths of wisdom Prov 3:17 , justice 8:20 (|| צְדָקָה אֹרַח ); light Job 24:13 ; ׳נ עוֺלָם Jer 6:16 (|| הַטּוֺב דֶּרֶךְ ); path of wicked Prov 1:15 ; Isa 59:8 (crooked), path of adulteress Prov 7:25 ; נְתִיבוֺת Jer 18:15 is rendered 'by-paths,' by Gf Rothst and others; < Gie makes construct before following לֹא דֶּרֶךְ סְלוּלָה נְתִיבָהּ֯ Prov 12:28 see נָתִיב .
definitions.rootNote: or (feminine) נְתִיבָה ; or נְתִבָה ; (Jeremiah 6:16), from an unused root meaning to tramp ;
